description: Illustrative minimal §0.47 air-gap lifecycle registry — one hard-offline stage and one network-degradable stage, plus the network-symbol the gate matches. The canonical registry carries the full five-stage spine (decide · enforce · emit · reconcile · assure).

stages.name: Decide — the Policy Decision Point
stages.invariant: The verdict is reached from the compiled policy bundle and the request context alone — no remote policy fetch, no remote identity lookup, no telemetry call on the verdict path.

stages.name: Reconcile — the declared-vs-deployed observer
stages.invariant: Observing an external deployment is this lane's purpose, so a network call is intrinsic; a probe blackout MUST degrade to a non-blocking verdict and never block a seal.

excluded_paths.reason: Prose, not an executable path — outside scanned_extensions. Declared rather than silently skipped (§0.43).

network_symbols.description: A call to the global fetch() — the most common outbound HTTP dependency.
